experiment_data.notes: Eval via eval_sta.py (Prover9Solver, FOL). PR=0.89, mean_isr=0.0619 (median=0). 72/89 proved samples have ISR=0 (redundant coding pattern per C006: model generates repeated ground facts like MinWage(m) x20, any single clause removable without affecting proof). Only 2 samples reach ISR=1.0. Very low ISR confirms random reward provides no signal for reasoning structure — model learns execution correctness but not meaningful proof construction. Consistent with random control hypothesis.
